summary: AISDLC-947 local-only anchor verification weakened the trust chain without a record

options.description: Keep local-only anchor verification until AISDLC-970 restores the control
Force a full review on every resume until AISDLC-970 restores the control

body: Retroactive record. The resume decision of AISDLC-947 relies on a review-state anchor verified on the signing machine only, so a CI verifier cannot confirm the portion of the PR outside a delta leaf. No decision record was filed. The restoring task is AISDLC-970 (committed delta chain walk in verify-core).
